title: Nevada volunteers remove 120,125 pounds of waste from Truckee River watershed

Their hard work resulted in the removal of an astounding 120,125 pounds of waste, which included both litter and invasive weeds. title: Essex farm flooded with seawater helped double saltmarsh across Thames estuary
description: In October 2002, a sea wall breach in Essex transformed farmland into a coastal wetland, increasing saltmarsh areas. This project, supported by various environmental organizations, aimed to restore natural habitats and manage coastal erosion. Marine life flourished, and biodiversity increased rapidly in the newly flooded areas after the breach. Traditional farming on higher land continued alongside saltmarsh restoration, contributing to sustainable agriculture.

title: Ted Turner bought 4,680-acre island to stop development; sold it for $4.9m
description: Ted Turner sold St Phillips Island to the South Carolina government for $4.9 million, much lower than its appraised value. The island will become part of South Carolina's state park system, focusing on ecosystem protection. Public access will be limited, allowing for educational programs and eco-tourism opportunities. Turner initially acquired the island in 1979 to prevent commercial development and has maintained its natural state.

title: 'No locus standi': India rejects Turkey president's remarks on Kashmir at UNGA

The MEA emphasized that no external party has a right to comment on India's territorial integrity. Erdogan suggested dialogue to resolve disputes, including the Kashmir issue, within the United Nations framework. India has consistently maintained that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of the nation.

title: Asian Games: Neeru, women’s 4x400m relay shine as 8-medal haul takes India past 50
description: Neeru Dhanda made history by clinching a gold medal in the women's trap event at the Asian Games, marking a significant achievement in Indian sports. The women's 4x400m relay team also triumphed, boosting India's medal tally to 53 and placing the nation 10th in the overall standings. Other athletes performed admirably across various competitions, while the boxing and volleyball teams made impressive strides, enhancing India's accomplishments.

title: New NCERT book says Indian kings got swords from goddesses to resist invasions
description: A new class nine social science textbook by NCERT titled 'Understanding Society: India and Beyond-Part 2' delves into India's historical experience with warfare. It emphasizes the cultural worship of deities like Kali and Durga for protection during conflicts, documents invasions from the seventh century, and highlights the valor of Indian rulers against foreign aggressors. This resource aims to enhance analytical thinking and foster intercultural dialogue among secondary students.

Ishaan's innovative approach combines geology and remote sensing to streamline mineral exploration. He is competing as a finalist in the 2026 Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge.

description: A Texas property developer recently demolished the Wood Residence, a historic mansion in Coral Gables, Florida. The estate, designed by Alfred Browning Parker, was not designated as a historic landmark. Local preservation advocates expressed frustration over regulatory loopholes allowing such demolitions without public hearings. The demolition reflects a broader trend driven by rising land values in South Florida’s luxury real estate market.

description: Residents of Nicollet Island are taking a united stand to purchase their cherished homes currently up for sale by TCHDC, due to financial strains affecting the nonprofit's ability to manage the properties. To safeguard affordable housing and the community's continuity, the Nicollet Island Cooperative has emerged. They are working alongside Land Bank Twin Cities to establish a buy-back arrangement, ensuring a stable future while negotiations with the property managers continue.

title: Watch: 2 girls, auto driver exchange blows on Bengaluru road over fare dispute
description: A video showing a fight between two girls and an auto driver in HSR Layout has gone viral online. The public video captures both sides exchanging blows until another girl intervened to stop the altercation. The police contacted the girls after the video circulated on social media, urging them to file a complaint. The auto driver alleged that he was assaulted after the girls refused to pay for their ride.

title: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan donate $4 million to save 600-year-old Hawaii fishpond
description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $4 million for the preservation of Alakoko Fishpond in Hawaii. This historic site, which is over 600 years old, faced potential environmental degradation and development pressure. The donation helped acquire the property for long-term stewardship by the nonprofit Mālama Hulē‘ia. Their initiative supports education about traditional Hawaiian aquaculture and native ecosystems.

title: 30-something heart: Inside a threefold spike striking young India
description: A significant increase in cardiovascular diseases is noted among younger Indians, impacting populations previously thought healthy. A recent survey indicates a threefold rise in heart-related ailments from 2017-2018 to 2025. Conditions like hypertension and diabetes are contributing factors for this rise. Unforeseen heart issues are emerging in individuals with no prior risk factors, showcasing a concerning trend. Urgent medical interventions are increasingly required for younger patients facing severe cardiac conditions.
